verdict_reason: Template correctly wraps the unchanged no-JS form in the shared multi-select-search macro and matches the prototype's search box, but duplicates the results-partial parameter mapping with search-results.njk.

todos.issue: The context-to-macro mapping for commoditySearchResults (copy, commodityGroups, noResults, carriedKeys, selectedSummary) is written out twice: search.njk:36-42 and search-results.njk:5-11, both mirroring the keys resultsContext() returns in search.controller.js:47-60. A key added to the results partial or to resultsContext must be threaded through both templates by hand, and missing one breaks only the JS path or only the no-JS path.
todos.fix: Must: one place owns which values the results partial receives; search.njk and search-results.njk both pass that one object through unchanged. One way: have resultsContext() return its values under a single key (e.g. results: { copy, commodityGroups, noResults, carriedKeys, selectedSummary }) and call commoditySearchResults(results) in both templates.
